entities.title: Superseded by human-assisted software development
entities.summary: Knowledge-driven development is no longer developed: human-assisted software development replaced it, and this repository stays as it was written.
entities.context: Knowledge-driven development keeps what a system should be in Markdown documents, each statement carrying a mark. Human-assisted software development keeps what a system knows about itself as structured metadata in .dev folders next to the code, maintained by agents and drawn by tools.
entities.decision: Mark it superseded and leave it as written. Repositories that adopted it can keep following it.

origin.description: The notice at the top of the README, added in commit 2d4adee (Mark knowledge-driven development as superseded).
